turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Hello, it's the surgery calling you back. How's the cough?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Still bad. I've had a cough with green phlegm for a week, and a temperature on and off.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Any chest pain or shortness of breath?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Yes, I'm allergic to penicillin. It gives me a rash.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: Okay. I'll prescribe doxycycline 100 mg once a day for five days.

turns.speaker: Doctor
turns.text: If you get short of breath or the fever gets worse, call back straight away.
